<a id="Aria"></a>

### WAI-ARIA

`Aria` · `src/html.ts:92`

The attributes that tell assistive technologies what an element is and how it is named.

Source: W3C, Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2: § 5.3 roles, § 6.7 states and properties · `https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `role` | `role` | What the element is, for assistive technologies |
| `group` | `group` | The role of a set of controls that belong together |
| `label` | `aria-label` | The name of the element, when no visible text gives it |
| `labelledBy` | `aria-labelledby` | The element whose text names this one |
| `pressed` | `aria-pressed` | Whether a toggle button is pressed |
| `hidden` | `aria-hidden` | The element is decoration: assistive technologies skip it |
| `link` | `link` | The role of an element that leads somewhere |
| `img` | `img` | The role of a drawing, read as one image with its label |
| `current` | `aria-current` | The element that is the current one of a set |
| `page` | `page` | The current page of a set of links |
| `expanded` | `aria-expanded` | Whether what the element controls is open |
| `button` | `button` | The role of an element that acts when activated |

<a id="Css"></a>

### CSS

`Css` · `src/html.ts:179`

The syntax of style sheets: rules, declarations, functions; the lengths a page uses.

Source: W3C, CSS Syntax Module Level 3 (§ 5 rules and declarations, § 4 tokens) · `https://www.w3.org/TR/css-syntax-3/`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `openBlock` | `{` | Opens the declarations of a rule |
| `closeBlock` | `}` | Closes them |
| `colon` | `:` | Separates a property from its value |
| `semicolon` | `;` | Ends a declaration |
| `openParenthesis` | `(` | Opens the arguments of a function, or a condition |
| `closeParenthesis` | `)` | Closes them |
| `space` | `" "` | Whitespace between the parts of a rule |
| `comma` | `,` | Separates the selectors of a list (Selectors Level 4, § 4.1) |
| `width` | `width` | The width of a box (CSS Box Sizing Level 3) |
| `minWidth` | `min-width` | The width it does not go under |
| `maxWidth` | `max-width` | The width it does not go over |
| `percent` | `%` | A length as a share of the box that holds it |
| `whole` | `100` | The whole of the box that holds it, as a share |
| `pixel` | `px` | A length in CSS pixels |

### HTML

`Html` · `src/html.ts:14`

Source: WHATWG HTML: § 13.1 Writing HTML documents (the DOCTYPE, elements, start and end tags, attributes); § 3.2.6 Global attributes; § 4 The elements of HTML · `https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/syntax.html#writing`
